title: An algorithm towards $\varepsilon$-factorising Feynman Integrals
summary: In this talk, we use several examples to elaborate on how a recently proposed algorithm can turn non-trivial Feynman integrals into an $\varepsilon $-factorised manner, regardless of their hidden geometric essence. In particular, some extra details about three-loop banana integrals with unequal-mass configuration are provided.
